title: Ekifo eky’okuwummulamu eky’omuntu omu
intro: Mu bitabo by’ebyafaayo eby’okusiimibwa Katonda, waliwo emmeeme ey’obulongoofu obutaliiko kye bufaanana, eyawuddwa ku bantu baabwe okunoonya obwannamunigina mu kkubo ettukuvu. Tebaamanya nti okweyawula kuno kwandireese akabonero eri ensi zonna, okugezesebwa okw’okukkiriza okwandibadde okwogerwako emirembe gyonna.
clues: Nnali neewaddeyo okubeera mu bulamu obw’obuweereza nga sinnazaalibwa.
Nateekebwa wansi w’obukuumi bwa nnabbi ow’ekitiibwa.
Nayimirizibwa n’eby’okulya okuva ewa Allah ebyawuniikiriza omukuumi wange.
Nnava mu maka gange ne ngenda mu kifo ekimu eky’ebuvanjuba.
Malayika yandabikira mu ngeri y’omuntu atuukiridde, ng’aleeta amawulire g’omwana omulongoofu.
Bwe nakomawo n’omwana wange omuwere, abantu bange banvunaana, naye omwana omuwere n’ayogera nga yeewozaako.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
